description: duplicate is the native destination of paste (ODC lane). (1) `parent` = another IContainer: the copy goes to its `content` placeholder. (2) `parent` = another UI flow: the copied screen is born in that flow. (3) Without `parent`: the outcome of a process decision lives in a Flows.Decision that the Model API hides under the IDecisionNode; the IDecisionNode does not accept the type and the copy goes to that container (before: 'The clipboard objects cannot be pasted into this target'). The copy of the outcome is deleted afterwards because a loose outcome has no incoming connector.

ops._why: parent is the IContainer; the paste goes to its content placeholder
proves the destination: the only IContainer inside DupBoxInto is the copy
the copied screen, with the content, is born in another UI flow
without parent: pastes into the hidden Flows.Decision, the native owner of the outcome
a loose outcome is left without an incoming connector; the proof is that the paste went through
